description: Verify content against all existing stamps. Pass a sha256 hash; matching is EXACT-BYTES-ONLY. Read the verdict fields: `exact` (these bytes are stamped), each proof's `publisher` (the verified identity: domain/handle + tier, or null meaning an unverified account, never trust a name that isn't in `publisher`), and `conflict` (2+ distinct signers claimed the same bytes; earliest anchored is listed first). A no-match on a re-encoded/screenshotted copy is EXPECTED and is not evidence of fakery: fetch the original and verify that. Free, no auth required.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex of the content bytes

name: verify_proof
